title: Q-179: Refactor: move claim-defining logic out of qnfo-workers (steps 0, 2-8)
body:

Migrated from GitHub issue 179 (Issues are off on the code repository; this file is the record).

Source of truth: ip/QNFO-REFACTOR-PLAN.md (branch agent/ip-claim-to-code). Steps 1 (parameterise reference copies) is done.

Remaining, in order, each with a work claim and shadow D1 run before switching:
- [ ] Step 0 freeze: path guard that does NOT publish the move-path list (ship in private artifact or directory-level CODEOWNERS; attorney review)
- [ ] Step 2 pin tests in both repos
- [ ] Step 3 move E (deploy-guard, canary_revert, deploy_probes, review_gate, claim_reaper, worker_release); canonical-deploy builds vendor/ from pinned artifact (build-artifacts.sh); fail closed; drift hash over bundled output
- [ ] Step 4 move C/D registries (fix tests reading migration paths)
- [ ] Step 5 move A/B manager SQL (identical allocations on shadow D1)
- [ ] Step 6 boundary and kit stubs (product_boundary.mjs core_scripts)
- [ ] Step 7 one-line headers for new migrations; replace PLUSSING.md with product description
- [ ] Step 8 retire public duplicates by ordinary commit, only after 24h fleet cycle and attorney sign-off; never rewrite history
- [ ] Extract fleet-control / fleet-dashboard anchors function by function (one per PR)
- [ ] Parameterise remaining QNFO literals in self-test fixtures
Doer: code loop / interactive session with work claim. Closing probe: public tree contains stubs only for moved paths and fleet probes green.

**Disposition:** fixed (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 222.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
